correctness.rationale: With [x,y]=z, every automorphism is (A,w), A in GL2(Fq), w a free central covector, acting by det(A) on z. Fixed vectors solve (A−I)v=0 and w(v)+(det A−1)t=0. For det A≠1 the fixed dimension equals dim ker(A−I); for determinant 1 it equals 1+dim(ker(A−I)∩ker w). The five GL2 strata (q(q+1)(q−2)^2, q(q+1)(q−2), q(q²−q−1), q²−1, 1) and central-covector incidences give exactly N0=q³(q+1)(q−2)², N1=q(2q⁴−q³−4q²−q+1), N2=(q²−1)(q+1), N3=1, valid q=2 and extensions. The polynomial sum equals q³(q−1)²(q+1), and weighted Burnside sum equals three times group order. Independent symbolic identities and q=2,3,4,5 numeric fibers checked; actual verify.py is rank-based exhaustive for q=2,3,4,5,7.
